params.text:
Based on my investigation of the csvkit project on GitHub (wireservice/csvkit), I found the following information:

1. The repository has 2,044 total commits
2. There are 99 contributors to the project
3. From the visible commit history on the main page, I can identify several frequent contributors including:
   - jpmckinney (appears frequently in recent commits)
   - dependabot[bot] (appears in dependency update commits)
   - alvaro-osvaldo-tm (appears in recent fixes)
   - Various other contributors

However, I was unable to access the detailed contributor statistics page to get exact commit counts per contributor. The contributor statistics page was loading slowly and I couldn't extract the precise data.

Based on the visible commit history and frequency of appearances, jpmckinney appears to be one of the most active contributors, but I cannot definitively confirm who has made the most contributions in terms of number of commits without access to the detailed contributor statistics.

To get the exact answer, you would need to:
1. Access the GitHub Insights > Contributors page for the repository
2. Wait for the contributor statistics to fully load
3. Extract the contributor data showing commit counts per contributor

Note: The csvkit project was not found in the GitLab instance, but was successfully located on GitHub where it appears to be actively maintained.
